summaries.name: Bruschetta
summaries.summary: Bruschetta is made with fresh tomatoes, basil, garlic, mozzarella, and balsamic glaze on toasted bread. The user planned to try this recipe first, alongside the Tomato and Mozzarella Salad, using fresh tomatoes from their garden.

summaries.name: Tomato and Mozzarella Salad
summaries.summary: Tomato and Mozzarella Salad consists of sliced fresh tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil, dressed with olive oil and balsamic vinegar. The user planned to try this recipe first, alongside Bruschetta, using fresh tomatoes from their garden.

summaries.name: blossom-end rot
summaries.summary: Blossom-end rot is a common tomato plant problem that can be prevented by side-dressing plants with calcium nitrate.

summaries.name: powdery mildew
summaries.summary: Powdery mildew is a disease sign to monitor for on tomato plants, alongside yellowing leaves and black spots.
